children: Ionic Digital received provisional Base Load classification from ERCOT for the remaining 466 MW energization request at its Ward County campus.
ERCOT provisionally classified Ionic Digital’s remaining 466 MW energization request as Base Load in the Batch Zero process.
Approval of the 466 MW tranche would bring Ward County campus to full aggregate demand of 700 MW.
Ionic Digital continues to target energization of the final tranche by end of 2027.
Classification is provisional and subject to ERCOT verification, audit and final determination with PUCT oversight.
Ionic Digital is fully participating in the verification process and cited focus on grid reliability and responsible data center development.
